rev.t: The food The food at Mainland China was too good! Everything tasted fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The dishes had great balance of spices and authentic flavors. Overall, it was a really satisfying experience and I would definitely recommend it to anyone who loves Chinese food.

It was my first time trying a Chinese buffet , the starters were so good especially the seafood fried wontons & dumplings. In main course i liked their chicken n egg fried rice . Don’t forget to try all the amazing desserts in dessert section. Must visit place with friends & family.
Ever since I left Kolkata, I've been craving Mainland China, especially since there aren't any outlets in NCR. So, the moment I reached Bangalore, I knew I had to visit. …
